title: hedera helix f. baltica
intro: Hedera helix f. baltica, commonly known as Baltic Ivy, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Baltic Ivy are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and exhibit sedative effects, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Baltic Ivy include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
